f4-spraypaint.changelog:
## F4 Spray Paint — Changelog (20.10.2026)

### New Features

Continue Painting
Players can now add to their own saved paintings. While placing corners, aim at one of your paintings and press E to keep drawing on top of it. Only the original artist can do this, and the server verifies it. Undo only removes the new strokes, so the original painting stays safe.

Smart Loading Queue
Paintings now load one at a time, nearest and on-screen first, instead of all at once. Loading pauses while driving above 30 km/h and continues when you slow down.

Client Cache
Paintings a player has already seen are stored locally and load instantly on the next visit, even after reconnecting.

---

### Performance

No More Loading Spikes
Fixed the 75–117 ms frame spikes when walking into an area with paintings. Painting data is now streamed in the background and is no longer decoded on the game thread.

Static Textures
Finished paintings are turned into a static texture and their browser instance (DUI) is closed, so saved paintings no longer each keep a browser open.

---

### Bug Fixes

Double Save
Fixed a painting being saved twice when Enter and the auto-save triggered at the same moment.

Unload Distance
Fixed Config.UnloadDistance being ignored, which made paintings reload at the edge of the render distance.

---

### Internal Changes

- Large paintings are drawn in small slices instead of one long task
- Displayed paintings no longer store undo snapshots, which greatly lowers memory use
- The eraser opens large paintings faster
- Fixed a texture dictionary leak on every painting reload
- New config options: RendererStaticTextures, RendererLoadInterval, RendererPrioritizeVisible, RendererLoadOffscreen, RendererPauseSpeedKmh, StrokeDataLatentBps, StrokeDataTimeout, ClientCacheEnabled, ClientCacheMaxEntries, ClientCacheMaxEntryKB, AllowContinuePainting, ConsumeSprayOnContinue, Keys.ContinuePainting, LogPaintContinue
- New open.lua hooks: OnSprayContinued (client) and OnServerSprayContinued (server)
- No database changes required
